description:
[Merchant] Get history of completed/finalized transactions with final statuses.

**Endpoint:** GET /transactions-history/{transactionId}
**Use Case:** Retrieve transactions with final statuses: CONFIRMED, DECLINED, FAILED, EXPIRED, CANCELLED.
**Note:** For ACTIVE transactions, use 'payware_operations_get_transaction_status' instead.

📦 **This is where the delivery address lives.** For a SHIPPABLE transaction, `deliveryAddress`
(fullName, streetAddressLine1/2, zipCode, city, region, country, phoneNumber, email) is returned
here and **only** here. It was removed from the finalized callback on 2026-08-07: a callback is
pushed to whatever URL is registered and its body stays in request logs and retry queues, which is
acceptable for a transaction id and an amount and not for a shopper's home address. This endpoint is
JWT-authenticated with your own credentials and tenant-scoped. So the pattern is: the callback
tells you the shipment is ready, and this call gives you the address to ship to.

🧾 **Lines and tip.** A payment with lines carries `items` and `total`: what was sold. A tip is never
a line: `tip` (absent without one) is yours, sent when you created the payment, or the payer's,
added in their bank where your shop allows tips; `tipEnteredBy` (`MERCHANT` or `PAYER`) says which. The payer paid `total` + `tip`.

⚠️ **Requires Standard or Premium.** This endpoint was ungated until 2026-08-21 and is now on the
same plan gate as the rest of the transaction surface, so a **Basic** merchant - or an ISV acting on
behalf of one - now gets **403**. If reading history started failing without a code change, this is
why. Financial institutions are unaffected; banks are always Premium.

⏱️ **Rate limited, like every payware endpoint.** A 429 carries `ERR_RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED` and a
`Retry-After` header, in seconds; the request was not processed, so the identical request is safe to
retry once the window passes. The failure result exposes this as `error.throttled`,
`error.retryable` and `error.retryAfterSeconds`.

partnerId.description: Partner ID from payware dashboard. Can use PAYWARE_PARTNER_ID env var as default.

privateKey.description: RSA private key for JWT token creation. Can use PAYWARE_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH env var as default.

transactionId.description: The pw transaction id. History looks the id up as given, so a product, placement, soundbite or POI id is not found: use the pw id the process response returned. Up to 32 characters (identifiers may grow beyond today's 10).

name: payware_operations_get_transaction_history
